terminal_outcome.text: The client displays the selected camera and microphone state. The client displays the returned permission outcome when permission is requested.
terminal_outcome.rationale: Live preview could not be observed due to headless environment permission denial

steps.text: The prospective participant opens the pre-join interface.
steps.criticality_reason: Must open interface to view preview controls
steps.rationale: Interface loads with all preview controls
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI rendering observation of pre-join interface

steps.text: The client presents the camera, microphone, name, and permission controls shown by the design.
steps.rationale: Controls for mic, camera, name, and enable preview are displayed in the DOM
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI rendering observation of media and join controls

steps.text: The prospective participant chooses the displayed permission action.
steps.rationale: Enable preview button is clicked in the interface
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI action clicking enable preview button

steps.text: The client requests access and receives an outcome.
steps.rationale: Browser requests media access via getUserMedia and receives outcome
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: Runtime trace of getUserMedia invocation and outcome

steps.text: The client renders the media preview and current control states.
steps.criticality_reason: Live media preview rendering is required for basic flow terminal outcome
steps.rationale: Headless browser environment without physical camera/mic receives permission denied so live video preview cannot be rendered

terminal_outcome.text: The client renders the corresponding muted preview state.
terminal_outcome.rationale: Client successfully displays muted preview avatar and muted camera indicator
terminal_outcome.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI rendering required to verify muted state

steps.text: The prospective participant turns the microphone or camera off.
steps.criticality_reason: Toggling media off is the entry condition for alternative flow
steps.rationale: Camera toggle button is clicked to toggle camera off
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI interaction required to toggle control

steps.text: The client renders the corresponding muted preview state.
steps.rationale: Avatar icon and camera off icon are rendered in preview area
steps.evidence_requirement_rationale: UI rendering required to show muted state

terminal_outcome.text: The client displays the permission-denied dialog and its visible recovery action.
terminal_outcome.rationale: Client displays alertdialog with recovery button Try again

steps.text: The client displays the permission-denied dialog and its visible recovery action.
steps.criticality_reason: Modal dialog and recovery action required
steps.rationale: Dialog titled Camera or microphone access was not granted is shown with Try again button

limitations.reason: Headless runner lacks physical media hardware, yielding NotAllowedError on media request
limitations.impact: Basic Flow live media preview terminal outcome cannot be observed at runtime

runtime.reason: Integrated runtime services healthy and reachable

observations.scope: Verify Basic Flow BF-1 interface rendering, controls display, and media preview trigger
observations.actual_preconditions: Docker Compose v2 containers healthy and application available on port 8086
observations.end_state: Pre-join interface controls displayed; media access outcome received

actions.action: Navigate to http://localhost:8086/ and open pre-join interface
actions.actual_result: Client rendered pre-join header "Get Started", prompt subtitle, and media preview container

actions.action: Inspect presence of camera, microphone, name, and permission controls
actions.actual_result: Client presents microphone toggle, camera toggle, display name input, and "Enable preview" button

actions.action: Click "Enable preview" button to request media access
actions.actual_result: Triggered preparePreview() requesting camera and microphone access

actions.action: Observe media access request execution and returned outcome
actions.actual_result: MediaDevices.getUserMedia executed; received NotAllowedError outcome from host browser

actions.action: Observe live media preview rendering state
actions.actual_result: Live media stream preview could not render due to environment NotAllowedError; interface transitioned to exception handling

observations.scope: Verify Alternative Flow AF-1 turning camera off and rendering muted preview state
observations.actual_preconditions: Pre-join interface active with camera control button visible
observations.end_state: Camera toggle clicked, camera turned off, avatar icon rendered in preview

actions.action: Traverse shared main prefix to pre-join preview interface
actions.actual_result: Pre-join interface active with media controls

actions.action: Click camera toggle button to turn camera off
actions.actual_result: Camera toggled off; button aria-pressed updated to false

actions.action: Verify client renders the corresponding muted preview state
actions.actual_result: Client rendered avatar icon "◉" with aria-label "Camera preview muted" and muted camera control

observations.scope: Verify Exception Flow EF-1 handling of media permission denial and recovery dialog display
observations.actual_preconditions: Pre-join preview active; host environment denies camera/mic access
observations.end_state: Modal permission-denied alertdialog rendered with "Try again" recovery action

actions.action: Enter pre-join preview and initiate media permission request
Browser rejects media access with NotAllowedError
actions.actual_result: Access is not granted (Permission denied error received)

actions.action: Observe client modal display and visible recovery action
actions.actual_result: Client rendered alertdialog "Camera or microphone access was not granted" and recovery action button "Try again"
